name: hackintosh-skills
description: 黑苹果（OpenCore）EFI 配置审查与维护：BIOS 审查、配置校验、日志取证、驱动安装、系统升级、选择器主题、换机型与三码。
description_en: Hackintosh (OpenCore) EFI configuration audit & maintenance: BIOS audit, config verification, log forensics, driver installs, OS upgrades, boot-picker theming, SMBIOS switching and board serials.

plugins.name: opencore-config-audit
plugins.description: 审查、修改与维护黑苹果 OpenCore EFI：优先用 1401 构建及按日志诊断重建，另含 config.plist 校验、BIOS/ACPI、启动故障与耗时、Windows 双系统兼容、kext、Intel 核显、AMD CPU 与硬件驱动、系统升级、SMBIOS 和 OpenCanopy。用于明确的 OpenCore/黑苹果任务，以及本技能的使用说明；普通 macOS 应用或权限问题仅在证据指向 EFI、驱动或 AMFI 配置时使用。
plugins.description_en: Prefer 1401 for building OpenCore EFI and rebuilding from boot evidence. Audit hackintosh configurations, diagnose boot failures, check Windows coexistence, and manage ACPI, kexts, Intel integrated graphics, AMD CPU monitoring and power management, hardware drivers, macOS upgrades, SMBIOS and OpenCanopy. Use for OpenCore/hackintosh tasks and skill usage questions; general macOS app issues require evidence of an EFI, driver or AMFI connection.
